original_forecast.resolution_rule: Up-event succeeds if the official/index-provider or consistently sourced S&P 500 close on 2026-08-11 exceeds the 2026-08-10 close of 7,753.11. Resolve the point and 80% interval against the same close source.
rationale: The updated model gives modest near-term downside pressure to the active oil/inflation/long-yield channel.
Strong aggregate earnings and the market's resilience to the Aug. 10 oil shock limit conviction in a risk-off move.
The July CPI release is not due until Aug. 12, leaving Tuesday primarily exposed to positioning and geopolitical/oil developments rather than a scheduled macro discriminator.
surprising_if: SPX rises more than 1.5% while WTI and long yields also rise materially without a positive earnings or policy catalyst.
SPX closes outside the stated 80% interval.

resolution.source: Associated Press, 2026-08-11 market close: S&P 500 closed at 7,728.20, down 0.3%.
resolution.audit_note: Forecast content above is preserved verbatim. The slight downside direction was correct and the point estimate beat both listed point benchmarks, but n=2 resolved forecasts remains far too small for any learning claim.
